title: Green-Lipped Mussels
description: Green-Lipped Mussels is a dish from New Zealand featuring garlic, green-lipped mussel, lemon juice, parsley. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 8 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Steam scrubbed green-lipped mussels under a tight lid until shells open; discard cracked shells before cooking and any unopened shells afterward.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
